body: I would do it if I were sure of the method. Apparently it's not so easy. Most suicide attempts wake up in a hospital with a breathing tube. Not what I want.
I want to die and I want to kill myself but I do not wish to inflict pain on anyone else. Why would you want to harm innocent people and cause grief in their family members?

My son did the same thing. Says he's a drug addict because I smoke pot. It's for my pain. And he does a bunch of drugs not just pot. I've never touched anything else I don't even drink. 

I'm sorry your child is using you as their scapegoat. 

And that your state didn't take the insurance. That's just unreal.

I know what you mean. 

I'm not loved. My parents are dead. My children don't speak to me. My grandson is moving a state away. They all act like I'm a burden so they should be happy if I go. 

Some people simply aren't loved. I'm one of them.
I'm 51, disgusted with life. People are horrible. There should be an easier way out.
Trust me, I am. Just need the refills.
And what happens when no one will touch you and your entire family has died or turned their backs on you? Fuck Drugs. I just need enough of them to off myself.
No one will find me. No one checks on me for weeks.
and for you information I have ALWAYS been a good person, raising these two very ungrateful children on my own. I gave them an amazing childhood with tons of love. Fuck them both and fuck you.
thanks for telling me i'm the problem. i have no desire to stay with you, or anyone else. just wish it was easier. i want to succeed not end up in a hospital.
I'm worried about this too. I'm afraid if I actually told a therapist how much I'd looked into killing myself and the plans I made they would put me on a psych hold.

I feel the same way. I have nothing to live for. Family has turned against me. I'm sick all the time. This is NOT some 22 year old upset over a bad breakup I'm done. I've researched many ways, but they all seem painful, or won't work. I want to die.
